<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.6.29</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.29">Released</a> on November 24, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>server - fixes misspells and other linting warnings @paularah (#6544)</li>
  <li>Upgrade Meshkit and add meshmodel APIs  @Revolyssup (#6565)</li>
  <li>Uncomment static k8s oam registeration @Revolyssup (#6562)</li>
  <li>[Extensions-cypress test fix] meshery-extensions redirections issue fix @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6558)</li>
  <li>Upgrade meshkit and meshmodel register API changes @Revolyssup (#6559)</li>
  <li>Send notifications on Content saving @Revolyssup (#6530)</li>
  <li>Move GetOAMWorkloads to ProviderAuth @Revolyssup (#6545)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fix issue #6273 - updated api endpoints and improved error messages for ‘mesheryctl exp filter’ commands @SufyaanKhateeb (#6434)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] improve the error messages shown to users for “mesheryctl” @XDRAGON2002 (#6356)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>removed warnings by adding key attributes @sam1code (#6426)</li>
  <li>Undeploy icon issue fixed on page: /configuration/patterns. @Krishna2323 (#6563)</li>
  <li>[Workflow] Build script Failing @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6557)</li>
  <li>[Node Configuration] Bugs fixes  @harkiratsm (#6547)</li>
  <li>[Events] Fix: Event Source is not getting created @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6546)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Workflow] Build script Failing @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6557)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Typo error corrected @AgniveshChaubey (#6555)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @AgniveshChaubey, @Chadha93, @Krishna2323, @Revolyssup, @SufyaanKhateeb, @XDRAGON2002, @harkiratsm, @l5io, @leecalcote, @paularah, @sam1code and l5io</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.6.30</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.30">Released</a> on November 25, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[CI] Decrease Golang requirements for Server builds @leecalcote (#6552)</li>
  <li>Fix empty namespace in Cyto conversion @Revolyssup (#6577)</li>
  <li>fix panic on error finding JWT claim @Revolyssup (#6576)</li>
  <li>Add Intel in ADOPTERS.md @gyohuangxin (#6570)</li>
  <li>readd introspect support, alongwith handling of infinite JWT @MUzairS15 (#6561)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[mesheryctl] improve error message shown to users for system lifestyle commands #6286 @devkapilbansal (#6437)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fix google avatars not loading in navbar @nishantwrp (#6571)</li>
  <li>Bump @babel/traverse from 7.19.4 to 7.20.1 in /ui @dependabot (#6468)</li>
  <li>Bump cypress from 10.9.0 to 10.11.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#6466)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump @babel/traverse from 7.19.4 to 7.20.1 in /ui @dependabot (#6468)</li>
  <li>Bump cypress from 10.9.0 to 10.11.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#6466)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Docs] Added instruction regarding redirect link on Docs and Contributing.md @asubedy (#6573)</li>
  <li>Readme, docs: update Meshery logo  @tinniaru3005 (#6441)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @MUzairS15, @Revolyssup, @asubedy, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @devkapilbansal, @gyohuangxin, @leecalcote, @nishantwrp and @tinniaru3005</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.6.31</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.31">Released</a> on December 02, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Bump decode-uri-component from 0.2.0 to 0.2.2 in /install/docker-extension/ui @dependabot (#6616)</li>
  <li>Add component updater utility @Revolyssup (#6582)</li>
  <li>Redirect to login in case of no cookie @MUzairS15 (#6595)</li>
  <li>Fix : icons and checkbox bg @harkiratsm (#6591)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Improve error messages for system context commands #6268 @devkapilbansal (#6613)</li>
  <li>Fix failing mesheryctl tests @Revolyssup (#6593)</li>
  <li>[Mesheryctl] View/Delete Configurations  @harkiratsm (#6174)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Added service mesh Icons in Navigator @Harshit-Dandriyal (#6614)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint-config-next from 12.3.1 to 13.0.6 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#6620)</li>
  <li>Fix: console errors on hovering navigator-icons @moki1202 (#6590)</li>
  <li>Bug fixed position on menu in text field @Udit-takkar (#6550)</li>
  <li>Bump tar from 6.1.11 to 6.1.12 in /ui @dependabot (#6463)</li>
  <li>Add no-referrer meta tag to fix 403 google avatars @nishantwrp (#6589)</li>
  <li>fix: ui-integration tests are unable to start @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6584)</li>
  <li>[UI] fix: use proptypes to fix type error @Udit-takkar (#6556)</li>
  <li>Fix: extension crash, while closing RJSF Form abruptly @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6583)</li>
  <li>Changed icons to SVG on RJSF form @asubedy (#6578)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump eslint-config-next from 12.3.1 to 13.0.6 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#6620)</li>
  <li>Bump react-relay and @types/react-relay in /ui @dependabot (#6599)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.31.10 to 7.31.11 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#6607)</li>
  <li>Bump decode-uri-component from 0.2.0 to 0.2.2 in /ui @dependabot (#6617)</li>
  <li>Bump cypress from 10.11.0 to 11.2.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#6605)</li>
  <li>Bump gonum.org/v1/gonum from 0.11.0 to 0.12.0 @dependabot (#6601)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/prometheus/client_golang from 1.13.0 to 1.14.0 @dependabot (#6600)</li>
  <li>Bump tar from 6.1.11 to 6.1.12 in /ui @dependabot (#6463)</li>
  <li>Bump golang.org/x/text from 0.3.7 to 0.4.0 @dependabot (#6465)</li>
  <li>[CI] Only run build workflow on upstream @leecalcote (#6585)</li>
  <li>fix: ui-integration tests are unable to start @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6584)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>The search bar is now not colliding with the Navbar from 768px to 995px  @UtkarshMishra12 (#6615)</li>
  <li>Update aks.md @acald-creator (#6588)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.6.32</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.32">Released</a> on December 05, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Always redirect to remote provide for playground deployments @Revolyssup (#6633)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Improve error message for mesheryctl mesh @PratikforCoding (#6625)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Krishna2323/issue/Icons-To_SVG @Krishna2323 (#6630)</li>
  <li>[Extensions] Meshery logo update for extensions @Chadha93 (#6635)</li>
  <li>[UI] Make catalog toggling as a user preference @Chadha93 (#6450)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[CD] Transition playground deployment VM-based to K8s-based @leecalcote (#6622)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Chadha93, @Krishna2323, @PratikforCoding, @Revolyssup, @leecalcote and @theBeginner86</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.6.33</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.33">Released</a> on December 07, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Replacing Mui icons to SVG’s. @Krishna2323 (#6637)</li>
  <li>[bug] Fix struct dereferencing  @theBeginner86 (#6648)</li>
  <li>[UI] Playground: Change verbiage for limited feature access @leecalcote (#6638)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[bug] Fix struct dereferencing  @theBeginner86 (#6648)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Removed deprecated GH actions @acald-creator (#6641)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Krishna2323, @Revolyssup, @acald-creator, @leecalcote, @theBeginner86 and l5io</p>
 

   <br/>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.6.34</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.34">Released</a> on December 09, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Update the save design toaster verbiage @Chadha93 (#6661)</li>
  <li>add make commands to debug in Docker extension @harkiratsm (#6654)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[chore] Removing deprecated packages @acald-creator (#6667)</li>
  <li>[server] Add Support To Logout Remote Provider Session @theBeginner86 (#6580)</li>
  <li>Enabled navigation of application grid @hs05june (#6655)</li>
  <li>
    <table>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td>[RJSF] Add a Custom Object Field to fix validation errors</td>
          <td>CU-3u6yyf2 @sudo-NithishKarthik (#6660)</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </li>
  <li>
    <MesheryConfigComponent> fixed the conflicting label @partik03 (#6657)
</MesheryConfigComponent>
  </li>
  <li>Made Configuration Icon consistent @hs05june (#6650)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[server] Add Support To Logout Remote Provider Session @theBeginner86 (#6580)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[chore] Removing deprecated packages @acald-creator (#6667)</li>
  <li>Update meshmodels and meshmodel workflows @Revolyssup (#6659)</li>
  <li>Update helm-chart-releaser.yml @acald-creator (#6649)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump nokogiri from 1.13.9 to 1.13.10 in /docs @dependabot (#6658)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Chadha93, @Revolyssup, @acald-creator, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @harkiratsm, @hs05june, @leecalcote, @partik03, @sudo-NithishKarthik, @theBeginner86 and Partik SIngh</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.6.35</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.35">Released</a> on December 14, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Fix panic @Revolyssup (#6707)</li>
  <li>Fix failing queries in case of custom telemetry deployment @MUzairS15 (#6705)</li>
  <li>Update script to add publish flag @sudo-NithishKarthik (#6704)</li>
  <li>Allow save operation for alternative format directly @Revolyssup (#6679)</li>
  <li>Remove overzealous notifications of design/app save @Revolyssup (#6697)</li>
  <li>Update contributing.md @Anand-Theertha (#6688)</li>
  <li>Edited Repository Overview Link @BabyElias (#6663)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Improve the error messages in <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl mesh</code>  @debasishbsws (#6626)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>disable some functionality in playground @harkiratsm (#6706)</li>
  <li>Instant fix of dashboard page.  @Harshit-Dandriyal (#6709)</li>
  <li>[Extension] show SignUp Form in Playground for restricted users to extension @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6703)</li>
  <li>Fixed telemetry bug and organized telemetry components @MUzairS15 (#6693)</li>
  <li>Temp fix to get animated logo css style for Next.js to compile @acald-creator (#6684)</li>
  <li>Ellipsis property added for button in context-switcher @deepakdinesh1123 (#6671)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>updated gh workflows to ubuntu version 22.04 @StarTrooper08 (#6689)</li>
  <li>Add token while checking out Meshery repo @Revolyssup (#6696)</li>
  <li>Add token while checking out Meshery repo @Revolyssup (#6695)</li>
  <li>Remove /docs path mandate on component updater @Revolyssup (#6694)</li>
  <li>Add path to commit action @Revolyssup (#6692)</li>
  <li>Add cron as trigger for component updation in docs @Revolyssup (#6691)</li>
  <li>[Draft] Add flag to update docs from spreadsheet @Revolyssup (#6682)</li>
  <li>[cleanup] Remove extraneous debug logs @theBeginner86 (#6668)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Add <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">system dashboard</code> to the mesheryctl command reference index @alphaX86 (#6643)</li>
  <li>Bump loofah from 2.18.0 to 2.19.1 in /docs @dependabot (#6699)</li>
  <li>Bump rails-html-sanitizer from 1.4.3 to 1.4.4 in /docs @dependabot (#6698)</li>
  <li>Edited repository overview link @BabyElias (#6664)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Anand-Theertha, @BabyElias, @Chadha93, @Harshit-Dandriyal, @MUzairS15, @Revolyssup, @StarTrooper08, @acald-creator, @alphaX86, @debasishbsws, @deepakdinesh1123, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @harkiratsm, @l5io, @leecalcote, @sudo-NithishKarthik, @theBeginner86 and l5io</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.6.36</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.36">Released</a> on December 22, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Fix bug on /api/meshmodel/components/types @Revolyssup (#6763)</li>
  <li>[Server] MeshModel Updater Comments and Doc @leecalcote (#6748)</li>
  <li>Add “Kubernetes” in meshmodel components @Revolyssup (#6751)</li>
  <li>Fix APIVersion bug in Meshmodel components @Revolyssup (#6757)</li>
  <li>Move meshmodel components under “components” folder @leecalcote (#6745)</li>
  <li>Replace carriage return with newline @Revolyssup (#6743)</li>
  <li>Add meshmodel components in Dockerfile @Revolyssup (#6741)</li>
  <li>Replace “output” with “meshmodel_components” @Revolyssup (#6740)</li>
  <li>Add meshmodel components @Revolyssup (#6738)</li>
  <li>[MeshModel] Add support for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">Relationships</code> @sudo-NithishKarthik (#6717)</li>
  <li>Change prettification logic @Revolyssup (#6727)</li>
  <li>Add apiVersion of a component in Design @Revolyssup (#6721)</li>
  <li>Move from draft-04 to draft-07 for k8s components @Revolyssup (#6723)</li>
  <li>Lowercase true/false in generated markdown @Revolyssup (#6720)</li>
  <li>Add configmap used to configure playground ingress @Revolyssup (#6676)</li>
  <li>Use helm chart name as dir @Revolyssup (#6716)</li>
  <li>Fix #6713 @Revolyssup (#6714)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.37">Released</a> on December 22, 2022</h4>

</ul>

</ul>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Revolyssup and @leecalcote</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Convert 2 API calls to 1 for Applications  @Revolyssup (#6752)</li>
  <li>Send notification of deployment failure @Revolyssup (#6772)</li>

</ul>

</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.6.39</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.39">Released</a> on December 29, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Fix NoAuth logic with respect to provider enforcement @Revolyssup (#6808)</li>
  <li>Upgrade meshkit @Revolyssup (#6795)</li>
  <li>Continue MeshModel registeration ignoring failure @Revolyssup (#6796)</li>
  <li>Add “Application” to MeshModel components @Revolyssup (#6677)</li>
  <li>Fix Applications import bug @Revolyssup (#6793)</li>
  <li>Return source type with application update responsne @Revolyssup (#6789)</li>
  <li>Allow POST on /api/application @Revolyssup (#6787)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Design Configurator : fonts, tooltips refractor @harkiratsm (#6755)</li>
  <li>Fix not able to upload JSON Board @MUzairS15 (#6802)</li>
  <li>fix: use optional chaining in /patterns @Udit-takkar (#6785)</li>
  <li>[cypress] migrate to cypress version 12 @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6681)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[bug] Fix User profile update @theBeginner86 (#6778)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>added public content from the Meshery Catalog BookInfoForCatalogIstio @aryabyte21 (#6775)</li>
  <li>[cypress] migrate to cypress version 12 @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6681)</li>
  <li>Change updater workflow to mandate both flags @Revolyssup (#6791)</li>
  <li>Change updater workflow @Revolyssup (#6790)</li>
  <li>Add support for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">component</code> level updation in MeshModels @Revolyssup (#6788)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Docs] Fixed Cilium calculation error on Compatibility Matrix @asubedy (#6801)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Changed calculation logic on the compatibility matrix @asubedy (#6786)</li>
  <li>Update README.md for better readability @chinu-anand (#6780)</li>
  <li>Each adapter page source their adapter-version-number dynamically @ayushthe1 (#6672)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Integrate Discussion Forum with Posts by Tag @leecalcote (#6773)</li>
  <li>fix: style for overview class @Udit-takkar (#6784)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Chadha93, @MUzairS15, @Revolyssup, @Udit-takkar, @UtkarshMishra12, @alphaX86, @aryabyte21, @asubedy, @ayushthe1, @chinu-anand, @harkiratsm, @l5io, @leecalcote, @theBeginner86 and l5io</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.6.4</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.4">Released</a> on August 31, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Reinstate gowrk2 submodule under <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">server</code> directory @alphaX86 (#6126)</li>
  <li>Fix clone on filters @gr455 (#6117)</li>
  <li>Upgrade nighthawk @gr455 (#6103)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-features">🚀 Features</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Server] Backend support for Meshery Catalog @gr455 (#6028)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>chore(mesheryctl): add loader to mesheryctl pattern apply @pk-218 (#6079)</li>
  <li>fix(ci): update <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">docker-compose.yaml</code> path @pk-218 (#6111)</li>
  <li>fix(ci/lint): fix failing lint check @pk-218 (#6113)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[UI] 50% width for input in RJSF @Chadha93 (#6129)</li>
  <li>[Extensions] Remote config icon update @Chadha93 (#6124)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.30.1 to 7.31.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#6116)</li>
  <li>[RJSF] fixed the size of the input field  @harkiratsm (#6101)</li>
  <li>RJSF Validation @harkiratsm (#6114)</li>
  <li>[Server] Backend support for Meshery Catalog @gr455 (#6028)</li>
  <li>Added a textoverflow ellipsis for rjsf  @harkiratsm (#6104)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">🔋 Patterns, Filters, Applications</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Server] Backend support for Meshery Catalog @gr455 (#6028)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Dependencies] meshkit and meshsync upgrades @leecalcote (#6130)</li>
  <li>[CI] Issue labeling update @leecalcote (#6122)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.30.1 to 7.31.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#6116)</li>
  <li>echo log in core E2E workflow for debugging @Revolyssup (#6121)</li>
  <li>Add_adapter_tests_resiliency_logic/#5900 @Zanda256 (#6102)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Docs]refactor: Merge Build and Releases page inside Contributing section @sambit-sankalp (#6074)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Chadha93, @MUzairS15, @Revolyssup, @Zanda256, @alphaX86, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @gr455, @harkiratsm, @l5io, @leecalcote, @pk-218 and @sambit-sankalp</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        if (parentCollapse) {
          parentCollapse.classList.add("show");
        }
      });
    });
  })();
  </script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.6.40</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.40">Released</a> on December 31, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Solve leftover bug due to merge conflict @Revolyssup (#6813)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>add a support for CustomTextTooltip in the formContext @harkiratsm (#6815)</li>
  <li>cypress: assign cy params to validate modal @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6812)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Docs] Meshery CLI Contributing Guide Details and Artifacts @leecalcote (#6811)</li>
  <li>Updated design spec doc links to point to detailed design spec doc @eeshaanSA (#6797)</li>
  <li>Add MeshModel endpoints to swagger docs @Revolyssup (#6806)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Revolyssup, @eeshaanSA, @harkiratsm, @leecalcote and l5io</p>
 

   <br/>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.6.41</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.41">Released</a> on January 06, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[CI] Fix image path in meshmodel docs @gr455 (#6840)</li>
  <li>Update SVG width and height in component updation @Revolyssup (#6839)</li>
  <li>[MeshModel] Define Status Types @sudo-NithishKarthik (#6831)</li>
  <li>Lowercase fields inside MeshModel metadata @Revolyssup (#6837)</li>
  <li>Migrate to MeshModel registry in pattern engine @Revolyssup (#6728)</li>
  <li>[CI] Fix build status badge in readme.md @leecalcote (#6828)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.6.42</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.42">Released</a> on January 12, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Refactor pattern engine logic to avoid invalid components  @Revolyssup (#6872)</li>
  <li>Bump json5 from 1.0.1 to 1.0.2 in /install/docker-extension/ui @dependabot (#6836)</li>
  <li>fix panic @Revolyssup (#6866)</li>
  <li>updated the link Meshery Contributors Welcome Guide @VedRatan (#6855)</li>
  <li>fix applications update not reflected @MUzairS15 (#6854)</li>
  <li>Fix component updater workflow logic @Revolyssup (#6853)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>improve <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">meshery pattern list</code> cmd error message @ayushthe1 (#6852)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump cypress from 11.2.0 to 12.2.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#6820)</li>
  <li>remove deprecated targets from meshery makefile @ayushthe1 (#6810)</li>
  <li>[CI] Fix: codecov update failure @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6869)</li>
  <li>[UI] Fixed the applications page modal bug @partik03 (#6804)</li>
  <li>[UI] Fixed the code mirror bug of filters page @partik03 (#6843)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump cypress from 11.2.0 to 12.2.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#6820)</li>
  <li>git auto commit action used to push changes to repo in discussions-data-files-update workflow @deepakdinesh1123 (#6845)</li>
  <li>remove deprecated targets from meshery makefile @ayushthe1 (#6810)</li>
  <li>[CI] Fix: codecov update failure @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6869)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Migrate older MeshModel endpoints to proposed MeshModel endpoints @Revolyssup (#6849)</li>
  <li>[Doc] - Meshery installation documentation update @gurpreet-legend (#6857)</li>
  <li>remove deprecated targets from meshery makefile @ayushthe1 (#6810)</li>
  <li>[Docs] - make command update in docs @gurpreet-legend (#6858)</li>
  <li>Fixing contributing.md @VedRatan (#6863)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Chadha93, @MUzairS15, @MarioArriaga92, @Nikhil-Ladha, @Revolyssup, @UtkarshMishra12, @VedRatan, @ayushthe1, @deepakdinesh1123, @dependabot, @gurpreet-legend, @leecalcote, @partik03 and Discussions Bot</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.6.43</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.43">Released</a> on January 13, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[Conversion] name, namespace, labels and annotations as root field @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6878)</li>
  <li>[MeshModel] Fix problem with #6875 @sudo-NithishKarthik (#6876)</li>
  <li>[MeshModel] Update API Routes to Allow Optional URL Vars @sudo-NithishKarthik (#6875)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[mesheryctl] improve error message shown to users for “mesheryctl system channel” command #6274 @devkapilbansal (#6430)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Playground] Redirect to playground based on capabilities, remove multiple api calls for capability query @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6879)</li>
</ul>
